senses.en: to give someone the right to vote
to free a slave (historical)

ex.en: The amendment would enfranchise citizens aged sixteen and older.
ex.zh: 這項修正案將賦予十六歲以上公民投票權。

root.note: 使有權利 → 給予選舉權

senses.en: to cause or give rise to a feeling or situation

ex.en: Unfair rules only engender resentment among workers.
ex.zh: 不公平的規定只會引起員工的不滿。

root.note: 使產生 → 引起

senses.en: to cut a design or words into a hard surface
to fix something firmly in the mind

ex.en: The jeweler will engrave our initials inside the rings.
ex.zh: 珠寶師會把我們名字的縮寫刻在戒指內側。

root.note: 刻進裡面 → 雕刻

senses.en: to absorb all the attention of someone

ex.en: A good mystery novel can engross me for hours.
ex.zh: 一本好的推理小說能讓我全神貫注好幾個小時。

root.note: 把（注意力）全部收入 → 使全神貫注

mn: 常用 be engrossed in：全神貫注於。

senses.en: to improve the quality, value, or extent of something

ex.en: A little lemon juice will enhance the flavor of the fish.
ex.zh: 加一點檸檬汁能提升魚的風味。

root.note: 使變高 → 提高

senses.en: a person or thing that is mysterious or difficult to understand

ex.en: How the ancient pyramids were built remains something of an enigma.
ex.zh: 古代金字塔是如何建造的，至今仍是個謎。

root.note: 謎語 → 謎

senses.en: to instruct or urge someone to do something
(law) to prohibit someone from doing something by court order

ex.en: The doctor will enjoin you to rest for at least a week.
ex.zh: 醫生會囑咐你至少休息一週。

root.note: 把責任加到某人身上 → 命令

senses.en: to arouse a feeling or passion; to set on fire

ex.en: A great teacher can enkindle a lifelong love of learning.
ex.zh: 一位好老師能點燃終身對學習的熱愛。

root.note: 使燃起 → 激起

senses.en: to give someone greater knowledge or understanding

ex.en: Could you enlighten me about how this machine works?
ex.zh: 你可以告訴我這台機器是怎麼運作的嗎？

root.note: 使心中有光 → 啟發

mn: the Enlightenment：18 世紀歐洲的啟蒙運動。

senses.en: to join or enroll someone in the armed forces
to ask for and obtain someone's help or support

ex.en: We need to enlist more volunteers for the beach cleanup.
ex.zh: 我們需要招募更多志工參加淨灘活動。

root.note: 列入名單 → 從軍、招募

senses.en: the state of being actively opposed or hostile to someone

ex.en: There was deep enmity between the two rival families.
ex.zh: 這兩個敵對家族之間存在深仇大恨。

root.note: 不是朋友 → 敵意

mn: enmity 和 enemy 同源：做敵人的狀態。

senses.en: to give someone a noble rank or title
to make someone or something more dignified

ex.en: Hard work can ennoble even the simplest job.
ex.zh: 勤奮能使最平凡的工作也變得崇高。

root.note: 使高貴

senses.en: the great size or seriousness of something bad
a very wicked act

ex.en: Only later did we realize the enormity of the disaster.
ex.zh: 直到後來我們才明白這場災難有多嚴重。

root.note: 超出常規 → 極度嚴重、暴行

mn: 傳統上 enormity 指「壞事的嚴重性」，中性的大小最好用 enormousness 或 magnitude。

senses.en: very large in size, quantity, or extent

ex.en: The project required an enormous amount of time and money.
ex.zh: 這個計畫需要龐大的時間和金錢。

root.note: 超出一般標準的 → 巨大的

senses.en: to make someone very angry

ex.en: Unfair decisions by the referee will enrage the fans.
ex.zh: 裁判不公的判決會激怒球迷。

root.note: 使狂怒 → 激怒

senses.en: to give intense pleasure or joy to

ex.en: Her singing seemed to enrapture everyone in the hall.
ex.zh: 她的歌聲似乎讓全場的人都陶醉了。

root.note: 使心神被攫住 → 使陶醉

senses.en: to place something precious in an appropriate place
to preserve a right or idea in a form that ensures respect

ex.en: The constitution will enshrine the right to free speech.
ex.zh: 憲法將明文保障言論自由的權利。

root.note: 放入神龕 → 奉為神聖、珍藏

senses.en: to catch in or as if in a trap

ex.en: The spider waits to ensnare insects in its web.
ex.zh: 蜘蛛等著用網捕捉昆蟲。

root.note: 使落入陷阱

senses.en: to involve something as a necessary part or consequence

ex.en: What exactly does this job entail?
ex.zh: 這份工作具體需要做些什麼？

parts.m: cut, limit 切、限定（古法語 taille）

root.note: 原指限定繼承人，引申為必然帶來 → 需要、牽涉

senses.en: to cause something to become twisted together or caught
to involve someone in difficult circumstances

ex.en: Fishing nets can entangle sea turtles and dolphins.
ex.zh: 漁網可能纏住海龜和海豚。

root.note: 使纏結在一起

senses.en: to capture the fascinated attention of

ex.en: The magician's tricks never fail to enthrall young audiences.
ex.zh: 魔術師的把戲總能迷住年幼的觀眾。

root.note: 使成為奴隸 → 使著迷

senses.en: to place a monarch on the throne
to give a place of great importance to

ex.en: The nation gathered to enthrone its new king.
ex.zh: 全國民眾齊聚一堂，為新國王舉行登基典禮。

root.note: 放上王座 → 使登基

senses.en: to say something that shows great excitement
to make someone interested and excited

ex.en: She will enthuse about her trip to anyone who listens.
ex.zh: 只要有人願意聽，她就會熱情地大談她的旅行。

root.note: 神附在體內 → 充滿熱情（逆構自 enthusiasm）

senses.en: having or showing intense and eager enjoyment or interest

ex.en: The team was enthusiastic about trying the new training plan.
ex.zh: 隊員們很熱衷嘗試新的訓練計畫。

root.note: 神附在體內的 → 熱情的

senses.en: the whole of something

ex.en: Please read the contract in its entirety before signing.
ex.zh: 簽名前請把合約從頭到尾讀完。

root.note: 整個 → 全部

mn: 常用片語 in its entirety（完整地、全部）。

senses.en: the scientific study of insects

ex.en: His love of beetles led him to study entomology in college.
ex.zh: 他對甲蟲的熱愛讓他在大學攻讀昆蟲學。

parts.m: insect 昆蟲（希臘文，原意「切成節」）

root.note: 研究昆蟲的學問

mn: entomology（昆蟲學）vs. etymology（字源學），常被搞混。

senses.en: the internal organs, especially the intestines, of a person or animal

ex.en: Ancient priests examined animal entrails to predict the future.
ex.zh: 古代祭司會查看動物內臟來預測未來。

root.note: 身體裡面的東西 → 內臟

senses.en: an earnest or humble request

ex.en: The king ignored every entreaty for mercy.
ex.zh: 國王對所有求情的懇求都置之不理。

root.note: 一再與人商量 → 懇求

senses.en: the main course of a meal (in American usage)
the right or opportunity to enter a group or place

ex.en: For my entree, I ordered grilled salmon.
ex.zh: 我的主菜點了烤鮭魚。

root.note: 進入 → 入場；原指正餐前的菜，美式指主菜

senses.en: to establish an attitude, habit, or belief so firmly that change is difficult
to dig trenches to protect troops

ex.en: Repeating a bad habit every day will only entrench it further.
ex.zh: 每天重複一個壞習慣只會讓它更根深蒂固。

root.note: 躲進壕溝固守 → 使根深蒂固

senses.en: to wind or twist together

ex.en: The two stories entwine in the final chapter.
ex.zh: 兩條故事線在最後一章交織在一起。

root.note: 纏繞在一起

senses.en: to mention a number of things one by one

ex.en: The report will enumerate the main causes of the accident.
ex.zh: 報告會逐一列出事故的主要原因。

root.note: 一個個數出來 → 列舉

senses.en: a long poem or story about heroic deeds
heroic or grand in scale
(informal) particularly impressive

ex.en: Homer's Odyssey is an epic about a hero's long journey home.
ex.zh: 荷馬的《奧德賽》是一部描寫英雄漫長歸鄉之旅的史詩。

parts.m: word, song 話語、詩歌（希臘文 epos）

root.note: 吟唱的長篇詩歌 → 史詩

senses.en: a person who takes great pleasure in fine food and drink

ex.en: As a true epicure, he traveled to Italy just to taste truffles.
ex.zh: 身為真正的美食家，他專程飛到義大利只為品嚐松露。

parts.m: Epicurus 伊比鳩魯（希臘哲學家）

root.note: 源自主張追求快樂的哲學家伊比鳩魯 → 美食家

senses.en: relating to the philosophy of Epicurus, which saw pleasure as the highest good
senses.zh: 伊比鳩魯學派的；享樂主義的

senses.en: devoted to refined enjoyment, especially of food and drink
a follower of Epicurus; a person devoted to pleasure
senses.zh: 伊比鳩魯學派的人；享樂主義者

ex.en: The Epicurean ideal was a calm life free from pain and fear.
ex.zh: 伊比鳩魯學派的理想是一種沒有痛苦與恐懼的平靜生活。

root.note: 伊比鳩魯學派的 → 享樂的

senses.en: (in old astronomy) a small circle whose center moves around a larger circle

ex.en: Ptolemy added an epicycle to explain why planets seemed to move backward.
ex.zh: 托勒密加入本輪，來解釋行星為何看似逆行。

root.note: 在圓上的圓 → 本輪

senses.en: a curve traced by a point on a circle rolling around the outside of another circle

ex.en: The toy drawing set lets children create an epicycloid with colored pens.
ex.zh: 這套繪圖玩具讓孩子用彩色筆畫出外擺線。

root.note: 在圓上滾動形成的圓形曲線 → 外擺線

senses.en: a widespread outbreak of an infectious disease in a community
a sudden, widespread increase in something undesirable
widespread; affecting many people at once

ex.en: The flu epidemic closed schools across the region.
ex.zh: 流感大流行使整個地區的學校停課。

root.note: 降臨在人民身上的 → 流行病

senses.en: the outer layer of the skin

ex.en: Sunburn damages the cells of the epidermis.
ex.zh: 曬傷會損害表皮細胞。

root.note: 皮膚上層 → 表皮

senses.en: a short, witty saying or poem

ex.en: Oscar Wilde was famous for his clever epigram, "I can resist everything except temptation."
ex.zh: 王爾德以一句妙語聞名：「除了誘惑，我什麼都能抗拒。」

root.note: 刻寫在（紀念物）上的短句 → 警句

senses.en: a section at the end of a book or play that comments on what has happened

ex.en: The epilogue shows the characters ten years later.
ex.zh: 尾聲描寫了角色們十年後的樣子。

root.note: 附加的話 → 結語

senses.en: a moment of sudden and great realization
(Epiphany) a Christian festival on January 6

ex.en: She had an epiphany: she wanted to be a teacher, not a lawyer.
ex.zh: 她突然頓悟：她想當老師，而不是律師。

root.note: （神）顯現 → 頓悟

senses.en: one part of a TV or radio series
an event or series of events forming part of a longer sequence

ex.en: I stayed up late to watch the final episode of the series.
ex.zh: 我熬夜看了這部影集的最後一集。

root.note: （希臘悲劇中）合唱之間插入的部分 → 插曲、一集

senses.en: words written in memory of a person, especially on a tombstone

ex.en: The epitaph on her grave read, "She loved and was loved."
ex.zh: 她墓碑上的墓誌銘寫著：「她愛人，也被人所愛。」

root.note: 刻在墳墓上的文字 → 墓誌銘

senses.en: a descriptive word or phrase added to a person's name
an insulting or abusive word

ex.en: Richard I earned the epithet "the Lionheart" for his bravery.
ex.zh: 理查一世因英勇而獲得「獅心王」的稱號。

root.note: 附加放上去的名稱 → 稱號

senses.en: a perfect example of a quality or type

ex.en: The hotel was the epitome of luxury.
ex.zh: 這家飯店是奢華的典範。

root.note: 切下來的精華摘要 → 縮影、典型

senses.en: (of a disease) spreading rapidly among animals
an outbreak of disease among animals

ex.en: An epizootic outbreak of bird flu forced farmers to cull their chickens.
ex.zh: 一波禽流感疫情迫使農民撲殺雞隻。

root.note: 降臨在動物身上的 → 動物流行性的

senses.en: a particular period of time in history or a person's life
(geology) a division of time within a period

ex.en: The invention of the steam engine marked a new epoch in history.
ex.zh: 蒸汽機的發明標誌著歷史的新紀元。

root.note: 停頓的時間點 → 紀元

senses.en: the third part of a classical Greek ode, after the strophe and antistrophe
senses.zh: （古希臘頌歌的）尾曲；長短句詩

ex.en: The chorus sang the epode after the strophe and antistrophe.
ex.zh: 合唱團在正旋舞歌與反旋舞歌之後唱出尾曲。

root.note: 附加的歌 → 尾曲

senses.en: to make things equal or uniform
(sports) to score a goal that makes the score even

ex.en: The new law aims to equalize funding between rich and poor schools.
ex.zh: 新法旨在讓富裕與貧窮學校的經費更平均。

root.note: 使相等

senses.en: mental calmness, especially in a difficult situation

ex.en: She accepted the bad news with remarkable equanimity.
ex.zh: 她以驚人的沉著接受了這個壞消息。

root.note: 心情平穩 → 沉著

senses.en: relating to horse riding
a person who rides horses skillfully

ex.en: The park features an equestrian statue of a famous general.
ex.zh: 公園裡有一座著名將軍的騎馬雕像。

root.note: 與馬有關的 → 馬術的

mn: 這裡的 equ 是「馬」，不是「相等」。

senses.en: a state in which opposing forces are balanced
a calm state of mind

ex.en: The market reaches equilibrium when supply matches demand.
ex.zh: 當供給與需求相符時，市場就達到均衡。

root.note: 天平兩邊相等 → 平衡

senses.en: fair and impartial

ex.en: We need an equitable way to divide the work.
ex.zh: 我們需要一個公平的方式來分配工作。

root.note: 平等對待的 → 公平的

senses.en: the quality of being fair and impartial
the value of shares or ownership in a company or property

ex.en: The school board is committed to equity for all students.
ex.zh: 教育委員會致力於讓所有學生享有公平。

root.note: 平等 → 公平

senses.en: equal in value, amount, meaning, or function
a thing that is equal to or corresponds with another

ex.en: A kilometer is roughly equivalent to 0.62 miles.
ex.zh: 一公里大約等於 0.62 英里。

root.note: 價值相等的 → 相當的

senses.en: to use vague language to avoid committing oneself or telling the truth

ex.en: When asked about the missing money, the treasurer began to equivocate.
ex.zh: 被問到失蹤的款項時，財務長開始支吾其詞。

root.note: 說出兩種意思同等可能的話 → 含糊其詞

senses.en: to destroy something completely; to get rid of

ex.en: Vaccines helped eradicate smallpox worldwide.
ex.zh: 疫苗幫助全世界根除了天花。

root.note: 連根拔出 → 根除

senses.en: straying from the proper course or standards
traveling in search of adventure

ex.en: An errant golf ball smashed the clubhouse window.
ex.zh: 一顆打偏的高爾夫球砸破了俱樂部會所的窗戶。

root.note: 走偏的 → 犯錯的；四處遊蕩的

senses.en: not even or regular in pattern or movement; unpredictable

ex.en: His erratic driving made the other drivers nervous.
ex.zh: 他忽快忽慢的開車方式讓其他駕駛很緊張。

root.note: 四處遊蕩的 → 不穩定的

senses.en: wrong; incorrect

ex.en: The article was based on erroneous information.
ex.zh: 這篇文章是根據錯誤的資訊寫成的。

root.note: 走錯的 → 錯誤的

senses.en: deep, extensive learning or knowledge

ex.en: The professor's erudition impressed even other experts.
ex.zh: 那位教授的博學連其他專家都佩服。

root.note: 脫離粗野無知 → 博學

mn: rude 原意是「未受教育的」，e-rud-ition 就是擺脫無知。

senses.en: to deliberately avoid using or doing something

ex.en: Many athletes eschew sugary drinks during training.
ex.zh: 許多運動員在訓練期間戒掉含糖飲料。

root.note: 避開 → 戒絕

senses.en: to catch sight of; to notice

ex.en: From the hilltop, we could espy a small cottage in the valley.
ex.zh: 從山頂上，我們可以看到山谷裡有一間小屋。

root.note: 偵察看到 → 發現

senses.en: a polite title added after a man's name (Esq.), or used for lawyers in the US
senses.zh: 先生（加在姓名後的尊稱）；（美）律師的頭銜

senses.en: (historical) a young nobleman who served a knight

ex.en: In medieval times, an esquire carried the knight's shield.
ex.zh: 在中世紀，騎士侍從負責替騎士拿盾牌。

parts.m: shield-bearer 持盾者（拉丁文 scutarius）

root.note: 替騎士持盾的人 → 侍從 → 尊稱

senses.en: the most important quality or basic nature of something
a concentrated extract of a plant or other substance

ex.en: The essence of good teaching is making students curious.
ex.zh: 好教學的精髓在於激發學生的好奇心。

root.note: 事物存在的根本 → 本質

senses.en: concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty (variant of aesthetic)
senses.zh: 美學的；審美的（aesthetic 的美式拼法）

senses.en: a set of principles about beauty or artistic style

ex.en: The building was designed for esthetic appeal as well as function.
ex.zh: 這棟建築的設計兼顧美感與實用。

root.note: 感官知覺的 → 審美的

senses.en: worthy of great respect
able to be estimated

ex.en: The award honors an estimable scholar who taught here for forty years.
ex.zh: 這個獎項表彰一位在此執教四十年的可敬學者。

root.note: 值得高度評價的 → 可敬的

senses.en: to cause someone to be no longer close or friendly with another

ex.en: A bitter argument over money could estrange the two brothers for years.
ex.zh: 一場為錢而起的激烈爭吵可能讓兩兄弟疏遠多年。

parts.m: foreign, strange 陌生的（拉丁文 extraneus）

root.note: 使變得陌生 → 使疏遠

mn: 常用 estranged：分居的、疏遠的（例如 estranged wife）。

senses.en: the wide mouth of a river where it meets the sea

ex.en: Many birds feed in the estuary where fresh water meets salt water.
ex.zh: 許多鳥類在淡水與海水交會的河口覓食。

root.note: 受潮汐影響的地方 → 河口

senses.en: relating to eugenics, the discredited practice of trying to improve human populations by controlled breeding

ex.en: Historians condemn the eugenic policies of the early twentieth century.
ex.zh: 歷史學家譴責二十世紀初的優生政策。

root.note: 好的出生 → 優生的

senses.en: to praise highly, especially someone who has died

ex.en: Friends gathered to eulogize the beloved teacher.
ex.zh: 朋友們齊聚一堂，頌揚這位深受愛戴的老師。

root.note: 說好話 → 頌揚

senses.en: a speech or piece of writing praising someone, especially at a funeral

ex.en: Her son delivered a moving eulogy at the funeral.
ex.zh: 她的兒子在葬禮上致了一篇感人的悼詞。

root.note: 說好話 → 頌詞、悼詞

mn: eulogy（頌詞、悼詞）vs. elegy（輓歌、哀歌）。

senses.en: a mild or indirect word used in place of one that seems harsh or blunt

ex.en: "Passed away" is a common euphemism for "died."
ex.zh: 「過世」是「死亡」常見的委婉說法。

root.note: 說好聽的話 → 委婉語

senses.en: pleasing to the ear

ex.en: Italian is often described as a euphonious language.
ex.zh: 義大利語常被形容為悅耳的語言。

root.note: 好聽的聲音 → 悅耳的

senses.en: the quality of being pleasing to the ear, especially in word choice

ex.en: Poets choose words for their euphony as well as their meaning.
ex.zh: 詩人選字時，除了意義也會考慮聲音是否悅耳。

root.note: 好聽的聲音 → 悅耳
